Version: vulnerable versions with CVSS ratings 8.6 and 9.8
Method of Attack: Directory traversal vulnerability leading to remote code execution (RCE)
Exploitation of case sensitivity issue in parameters
Discoverer: US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA)
Attack Vector: Web application resource (WAR) file implementing a web shell
Passing the same parameter with two different cases to override settings
Indicators of Compromise: GitHub repository used for PoC demonstration
Steady rate of 2,000 to 3,000 daily downloads of vulnerable framework from Maven Central
